comments: Client-cert SAN suffix policy is implemented: config.go parses AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX, exposes it in config, and server.go enforces it both at HTTP request entry and at the TLS handshake (VerifyConnection).

Audit logging of client-cert subject and serial is present: session.start events in both handleConnect and handleWebSocket now log mtls_subject and mtls_serial, and there is a dedicated logClientCertAudit for additional audit.
No regression of TLS1.2+, mTLS, or cipher suite restrictions: server.go still sets MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, requires client certs, and restricts cipher suites and curves as before.
Deployment wires the new env var: deployment.yaml includes AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX in the container env list, with documentation.
General code quality is good; enforcement is at both handshake and request time, and config is surfaced and documented.
